blocks.text: IoT works through three main functions: data collection, communication, and automation. Sensors collect data from the environment, such as temperature, movement, or humidity. This data is then sent to cloud-based systems or servers where it is processed and analyzed. The analyzed data can trigger specific actions automatically, such as turning off lights when no one is in a room or starting irrigation when the soil becomes dry.

Communication between devices ensures that systems remain synchronized and efficient. Automation reduces the need for manual control, saving time and minimizing human error. By combining real-time data with intelligent decision-making, IoT creates smarter, safer, and more efficient environments for homes, industries, and communities.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Sketch a smart home system that uses IoT devices (lights, fans, sensors). Label how each device collects and communicates data.
